# Retained benchmark receipt fixtures

These are byte-preserving copies of predecessor test outputs, not regenerated by the
combined implementation. Each directory retains its original manifest and freeze.
They are synthetic correctness fixtures, not benchmark results.

- `sha-v2`: task200 r3 `checks/bt-green/test_each_schema_verifies_unde0/run`.
- `policy-v3`: task200 r3 `checks/bt-green/test_each_schema_verifies_unde1/run`.
- `a1-v3`: A1 Owner review `pytest/test_compare_certifies_nothing0/valid`.

Original evidence roots:
`/anvil/scratch/onetree-bench-task200-r3-e856-20260918` and
`/anvil/scratch/onetree-task26-seeds-owner-review-20260917`.

The two v3 formats have different corpus derivations. A1 keeps the earlier event,
metric and exclusion rules; the policy candidate has lifecycle observations and
narrowed exclusions. Neither is reinterpreted as the combined v4 format.
